Three killed in Haridwar road accident involving bus and truck

A fatal road accident occurred in Haridwar, India, where a Rodez bus collided with a pickup truck. Three people lost their lives in the crash, which also injured others. The incident happened under a flyover, and authorities are investigating the cause of the accident.
